name: @fraziym/tree-sitters
description: FRAZIYM-maintained tree-sitter grammar collection. Vendored from upstream tree-sitter-* npm packages that have no prebuilds and fail native compilation on Node 22+ Windows CI runners. Each grammar ships as a sub-package with platform prebuilds (linux-x64, win32-x64, darwin-arm64, darwin-x64) so install NEVER triggers node-gyp rebuild.
author: AKIK FARAJI <akikfaraji@gmail.com> (https://fraziym.com)

scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); for (const g of fs.readdirSync('grammars')) { const p=`grammars/${g}/build`; try{fs.rmSync(p,{recursive:true,force:true})}catch{} }"
scripts.list: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); console.log('Available grammars:'); for (const g of fs.readdirSync('grammars').filter(d=>fs.statSync(`grammars/${d}`).isDirectory())) { console.log('  -', g); }"
